This overview file describes how to run the income and growth analysis using a synthetic panel of individual incomes.
It provides links to the computational code (QMD) and output (HTML).
The simulated data are intended to verify that the analytical procedures run successfully; they do not reproduce the figures or estimates in the paper.

First, run [01_data_simulation.qmd](01_data_simulation.qmd) to save `sample_size_tb` and `sample_growth_tb` in `../income_board_replicate/`.
In 01, log income at age 20 is generated from a Laplace distribution and annual log growth rates from a signed Weibull distribution for 1.5 million individuals born in 1950–2000.
Then run each analysis in 02–11.
Use the folder containing each QMD as its working directory during execution.
Both the output directory for 01 and the input directory for 02–11 are `../income_board_replicate`.
